privacy.metaDescription: Itemised DPDP Act 2023 & Rules 2025 privacy notice for Saath: minimal data collected, never-stored fields, 6 sub-processors, retention windows, and Data Principal rights.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy & DPDP Notice
privacy.subtitle: Issued under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 & DPDP Rules, 2025 (Notice v1.0).
privacy.effectiveNote: Effective Date & Legal Entity: Saath Travel Technologies Pvt. Ltd. [TO BE CONFIRMED BY COUNSEL] · Registered Address: Bengaluru / Mumbai, India [TO BE CONFIRMED BY COUNSEL].
privacy.collectedPhone: Mobile number: encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) with an HMAC-SHA256 blind index for authentication and OTP delivery.
privacy.collectedProfile: Optional display alias, preferred language (en/hi), self-declared gender (used strictly for Women-only swaps), notification channel preferences, and device Web Push keys.
privacy.collectedJourney: Journey schedule metadata, coach/berth/seat codes, coarse age band (child/adult/senior/unknown), gender band (F/M/U), and one-way HMAC-SHA256 PNR hash.
privacy.collectedConsents: Itemised DPDP consent ledger across 5 purposes (verification, matching, notifications, analytics, whatsapp) with notice version and timestamps.
privacy.neverStoredPnr: Raw 10-digit railway PNRs or 7-character airline PNR codes are never written to our database.
privacy.neverStoredNames: Passenger full names, exact ages, and minor identities are stripped during ticket parsing and never persisted (minors appear only as age_band=child).
privacy.neverStoredImages: Boarding pass images or PDFs are decoded on your device using WebAssembly and never uploaded to Saath servers.
privacy.neverStoredLlm: Raw PNRs, passenger names, and phone numbers are never sent to AI models (Anthropic Claude).
privacy.processorCloudflare: Cloudflare — Edge CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, and Turnstile bot verification.
privacy.processorRailway: Railway — Cloud application hosting (India/Mumbai region), managed PostgreSQL 16 & Redis 7 with TLS 1.3 and encryption at rest.
privacy.processorPosthog: PostHog — Server-side product funnel analytics with strict PII masking (opt-in analytics consent).
privacy.processorMsg91: MSG91 — TRAI DLT-registered SMS OTP and transactional alert delivery.
privacy.processorMeta: Meta (WhatsApp Cloud API) — WhatsApp OTPs, swap templates, and interactive PNR bot messages.
privacy.processorAnthropic: Anthropic (Claude API) — Swap Concierge, polite outreach drafts, and chat translation/moderation with zero raw PII.
privacy.retentionJourney: PNR hashes, bookings, seat holders, parties, goals, and chat messages: Journey arrival + 30 days (automatically purged nightly).
privacy.retentionSwaps: Pseudonymous swap records and signed Swap Cards: 2 years for Karma and dispute integrity.
privacy.retentionReports: Safety/moderation reports and CERT-In ICT security logs: 180 days rolling in India.
privacy.retentionInvites: Seat invite links: 72 hours. Party invite links: 48 hours. OTP hashes in Redis: 60 seconds.
privacy.retentionErasure: Account deletion (DELETE /v1/me): Immediate session/token revocation, Karma ledger anonymisation, and full PII erasure within 24 hours.
privacy.rightsBody: You may review or withdraw optional consents, export a portable ZIP archive of your data, or permanently delete your account from your Profile, or escalate any concern to our Grievance Officer.
privacy.manageProfileCta: Manage consents, export & delete on Profile

terms.metaDescription: Saath Terms of Use: 18+ eligibility, TTE/cabin crew final authority, no IRCTC or airline affiliation, and ₹0 peer-to-peer swap commitment.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: Clear rules for safe, free peer-to-peer seat coordination on trains and flights.
terms.entityNote: Operator: Saath Travel Technologies Pvt. Ltd. [TO BE CONFIRMED BY COUNSEL] · Governing Law & Jurisdiction: India [TO BE CONFIRMED BY COUNSEL].
terms.ageBody: You must be 18 years or older to create a Saath account or agree to a seat swap. Minors under 18 may only be included as non-identified party members (age_band=child) on a verified adult's booking; no minor's name, exact age, or phone number is collected.
terms.tteHeading: 2. Final Authority of TTE & Airline Cabin Crew
terms.tteBody: Every swap arranged on Saath is an informal, mutual passenger arrangement and remains strictly subject to on-board TTE (Travelling Ticket Examiner) or airline cabin crew approval and safety rules (such as DGCA exit-row eligibility). A Saath Swap Card does not amend official PNR records or reservation charts.
terms.affiliationHeading: 3. No Affiliation with IRCTC, Indian Railways, Airlines, or DGCA
terms.affiliationBody: Saath is an independent peer-to-peer coordination platform. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an authorised agent of IRCTC, Indian Railways, CRIS, IndiGo, Air India, Akasa Air, SpiceJet, or DGCA, and we do not sell or book tickets.
terms.freeBody: Peer-to-peer seat swaps on Saath are free (₹0) forever. Selling, auctioning, or demanding money, UPI transfers, or gifts for a seat—or transferring non-transferable tickets—is strictly prohibited and results in immediate account ban. Optional paid tools (such as Group-Organiser Trip Pass at ₹199) never buy seat priority.
terms.conductBody: Do not harass co-travellers, submit duplicate or fraudulent boarding passes, or share phone numbers/UPI IDs before mutual swap acceptance. Users can block and report misconduct at any time; 3 distinct reports trigger automatic account restriction.
